stories.title: Trump says Norway has indelible stain for not awarding him Nobel Peace Prize

en.title: Trump says Norway has indelible stain for not awarding him Nobel Peace Prize
en.summary: US President Trump criticized Norway and the Nobel Committee for awarding the Peace Prize to Navi Pillay, a former International Criminal Court judge, rather than to him, describing the decision as disgraceful and embarrassing.

stories.title: Democrats accuse Trump of betraying Ukraine, allies in diesel deal with Putin

en.title: Democrats accuse Trump of betraying Ukraine, allies in diesel deal with Putin
en.summary: Democratic officials and Ukrainian President Zelensky criticized Trump's announced diesel agreement with Putin, claiming it undermines Ukraine and US national security while potentially enabling Russia to continue its military campaign.

stories.title: Israel’s scorn of Nobel Peace Prize laureate highlights its combative relationship with UN bodies

en.title: Israel's scorn of Nobel Peace Prize laureate highlights its combative relationship with UN bodies
en.summary: Israel's dismissive response to Navi Pillay's Nobel Peace Prize award reflects growing tensions between Israel and international institutions over the Gaza conflict and enforcement of international law.

stories.title: Trump Says Putin Agrees to Major Release of Diesel to US, Global Markets

en.title: Trump Says Putin Agrees to Major Release of Diesel to US, Global Markets
en.summary: Trump claimed that Putin agreed to a significant diesel supply release intended for the United States and global markets.

stories.title: Saudi Arabia will not allow Yemen to become launchpad for attacks on Kingdom: UN envoy

en.title: Saudi Arabia will not allow Yemen to become launchpad for attacks on Kingdom: UN envoy
en.summary: Saudi Arabia's UN representative stated that the kingdom will not permit Yemen to be used as a base for attacks against Saudi Arabia or threats to Red Sea shipping. He emphasized Saudi Arabia's commitment to protecting its sovereignty and citizens amid intensified Houthi attacks on Saudi territory.

en.title: Trump: Putin Committed to Supplying Large Quantities of Diesel to American and Global Markets
en.summary: U.S. President Trump announced that Russian President Putin has committed to delivering millions of tons of diesel to American and global markets over several months following a productive conversation between the two leaders.

stories.title: Trump says Russia to supply diesel to US and global market

en.title: Trump says Russia to supply diesel to US and global market
en.summary: President Trump announced that Russia agreed to supply over 300,000 tons of diesel to the US and global markets. The move aims to reduce diesel prices ahead of November midterm elections, as fuel costs remain near record levels.

stories.title: Praise pours in for Nobel Peace Prize laureate Navi Pillay

en.title: Praise pours in for Nobel Peace Prize laureate Navi Pillay
en.summary: South African jurist Navi Pillay, an 85-year-old former UN human rights chief, received the Nobel Peace Prize. She was recognized for decades of work in international justice, including investigating crimes and serving as an ad hoc judge at the UN's International Court of Justice.

stories.title: Coalition destroys three Houthi missile launchers, vows firm response to attacks on civilians

en.title: Coalition destroys three Houthi missile launchers, vows firm response to attacks on civilians
en.summary: The Coalition to Support Legitimacy in Yemen announced destruction of three Houthi missile launchers on Thursday and pledged decisive action against attacks targeting civilians and civilian infrastructure.

en.title: Coalition: 3 Houthi Missile Launchers Destroyed
en.summary: A coalition spokesperson reported the destruction of three Houthi missile launch platforms as part of regional security efforts.

en.title: Navanethem 'Navi' Pillay Wins the Nobel Peace Prize for Her Work in International Justice
en.summary: Navanethem Pillay has been awarded the Nobel Peace Prize in recognition of her contributions to international justice.

stories.title: ‎Saudi US stock trading hits record SAR 302B

en.title: Saudi US stock trading hits record SAR 302B
en.summary: Trading in US stock markets by Saudi capital market institutions reached SAR 302.2 billion in Q2 2026, representing a 56% increase from the previous year's same quarter.

stories.title: ‎GACA: 3 killed in attacks on Riyadh airport, Saudia aircraft

en.title: GACA: 3 killed in attacks on Riyadh airport, Saudia aircraft
en.summary: Two attacks targeted King Khalid International Airport on October 8, 2026, with one striking airport facilities and another damaging a parked Saudia aircraft. Three Saudi nationals were killed and multiple people injured, with material damage also reported.

stories.title: ‎30 Million Umrah Pilgrims.. But Who Owns the Journey?

en.title: 30 Million Umrah Pilgrims.. But Who Owns the Journey?
en.summary: Saudi Arabia received 18.03 million Umrah pilgrims from abroad in 2025 against a 2030 target of 30 million, though only 12.44 million of the 15.03 million visas issued were specifically for Umrah purposes. The discrepancy raises questions about market composition.

stories.title: ‎Gold holds gains as dollar steadies; silver jumps 2%

en.title: Gold holds gains as dollar steadies; silver jumps 2%
en.summary: Gold and silver prices rose on Friday as the US Dollar Index remained relatively stable, supported by lower oil prices and ongoing uncertainty regarding US-Iran relations.

stories.title: ‎Oil pares losses after Ukraine targets Russian refinery

en.title: Oil pares losses after Ukraine targets Russian refinery
en.summary: Ukraine attacked Russia's Ukhta oil refinery operated by Lukoil, located 1,900 kilometers from the Ukrainian border. Oil prices recovered some losses as tensions between Moscow and Kyiv intensified, while markets monitored potential Middle East de-escalation developments.
